title: Studio create dialog: 'Save as draft' stays disabled until a name is entered and never says why
body:
qa#2 · os-bob · session_012dn2Acf5wtyrf2yKWCThBj

QA-source: #32102 · ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason · acceptance[0]

Found by the QA run #32102 (subject `ff04ad81`).

## Reproduction

1. As admin, create a writable package: `POST /api/v1/packages {"manifest":{"id":"com.qa.pubprobe","name":"QA Pub Probe","version":"0.1.0","type":"app","namespace":"qapp"}}`.
2. Open `/_console/studio/com.qa.pubprobe/data` and click New object.
3. Leave the name empty. "Save as draft" is natively disabled, with no title, no aria-describedby and no wrapper. Hover shows no tooltip, and Tab skips it.

Reproduced on 2 fresh loads.

**Expected:** a stated reason (for example "Enter a name first") on a focusable wrapper, or validation on submit.

## Mechanism

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/CreateItemDialog.tsx` line 189: the submit Button has `onClick={submit} disabled={!valid || busy}`, with `valid` computed around line 121. The dialog is shared by Studio's create flows, so every create surface inherits the problem.

Owning package: `@object-ui/app-shell`.
